2fe0482f2c0b89ed.text: Reyes. My name is Reyes. That is not true and I keep saying it. Go west of the ruins, where my crew went down. Someone should see it who is still breathing.

ac355b86076336a5.text: West of the ruins. You will know the place. Nothing grows there now.

d3b628cca8ce921a.text: You have not gone yet. They are still lying where they fell.

23d028e77f47eb43.text: You saw them. Good. Sorensen's aid post is east of the plaza. The living need you more than they do.

82008a3ec81510a1.text: Go on. I cannot follow. It will not let me leave this gate.

125e7944263b71e9.text: I'm out of everything. Our resupply is sitting in the southern ruins with about thirty Taken walking circles around it. Get to the cache and I can keep people breathing.

42a7430e9fb720a1.text: Straight south into the ruins. Don't stop moving in there.

66d674c8672ebff5.text: No cache, no patients — that's the arithmetic. Please hurry.

75c2f14cb7b93dbb.text: That's blood and bandages for a week. Patched you up too. Halloran is in the northwest quarters. She has been asking for someone who can still walk that far.

e7b9545ae8cd94fb.text: Stay whole. I'd rather not see you on this table.

65f4cd180a856f48.text: Everything Corvus recorded about the specimen is on one core in the northeast warehouse, including who authorised keeping it alive. I want that name. Bring it to me.

37d91021c7654388.text: Northeast warehouse. And do not read it on the way back.

9ca103aab3c77666.text: Without that core we are guessing, and I am tired of guessing.

79ddb9565abe3ba5.text: Countersigned by the man on the tower roof. He has been here since day one. Park is out on the east ridge. Tell him I said run.

c2546878b4b9f9b7.text: He signed it. He is still standing up there. I cannot get past that.

e2cbd99b703300e1.text: There's a man in a suit standing on top of the command tower and he has not moved in three days. I want a relay at the base of that tower so we can hear what he's transmitting. Do it and get clear.

9b5c8e41962d9208.text: Base of the tower, dead centre of the plaza. Don't look up.

05634c565e1cb093.text: No relay, no idea what he's saying. Or to whom.

b744a4cc945f1c3b.text: It's a carrier signal. Outbound. He's reporting on you — and something out there is answering. Get to extraction.

81f9ba4328dfb9cb.text: Whatever's listening already knows your name. Go.

3f4b72e7e74c19cc.text: Stop right there. Nobody walks into the Sprawl blind. We have people alive past this gate and no way to reach them — the yard beyond is HECU ground. Say the word and I open it, but the second it moves they will know you're coming. Find one of ours and get them talking.

48b20eaa5a1d5da6.text: Opening the gate. Take the crate first, then hit Q — the suit reads bio-signals and you'll want to know who's breathing before you round a corner. My two are with you. Move!

5abd005a5328738d.text: Gate's open and the yard's hot. Go find our people.

69968bc41190b771.text: You found one. That's more than we managed in two days. Take the resupply — and whatever that thing out there told you, keep walking.

e2049fbcd1e7bd0c.text: Gate stays open. Bring them home if you can.

456cb6025662dfd2.text: You are at the south gate of the Corvus Sprawl. There are people alive past this wall, and the army outside has orders not to let anyone through it.

866ec49b0990fac2.text: You found one of the survivors. Good. Keep a count for me. I have to put a number in the report.

7d336968db9e7e5b.text: The machine by the gate still talks. It uses the name of the man it was working beside when this started.

b9527511abe5826a.text: Forty-one was a maintenance unit. Whatever is riding it kept the parts of him it found useful. Speech, mostly.

aa54fbacb8fbc539.text: Medical stores located in the southern ruins. Casualties inside the Sprawl are still rising.

230b541dd9a2d526.text: Sorensen thinks a relief column is coming. I have seen what the army has parked on the ridge. It is not a relief column.

191dc24efc5824ee.text: Halloran wants the site log off a data core in the northeast warehouse. She wants to know who signed off on keeping the thing alive.

7834abfb285bd6ee.text: Corvus authorised it. I countersigned it. I would sign it again. It was a very good contract.

acd06d7b36292106.text: Encrypted transmission from the command tower. Outbound. Running continuously for seventy-one hours.

2183f210edc1fbf6.text: Yes, I have been sending. No, not for help. Corvus wants the specimen recovered before the army burns this valley flat. Both of those are still on the table.

a3cbcc8857326810.text: The containment field would have sealed that breach on day one. My people put three pylons around it to hold the field down, because a dead specimen is worth nothing. Leave them standing and walk to the helicopter with me.

430fbff320e8a184.text: Three field pylons detected at the breach. Destructible.

4aec0470dcfc0fa6.text: He keeps calling it an offer. He has not once called it a way to fix this.

f1d61267525c18ac.text: The field came back up. Whatever is left down there is sealed in with it, and forty-one people get to walk out.

d919e90d62b7279d.text: You have cost my employer a great deal of money. I will write that down exactly as it happened. It is the one part of this that anybody will believe.

9b66677deda64216.text: Suit online. Air is bad but breathable. This base went quiet three days ago.

6c4bf3cffc712321.text: Something got out of the research station east of here. It came down this road. Whatever it is, it does not stay in one body.

00462dc70ec08d34.text: Corvus sent me to write up what happened here. I have written up four of these. They read very much alike.

1a1a1ae44530197b.text: Warning. The army has sealed this valley. They are firing on anyone leaving it. Forty-one people are still alive inside the wire.

0c7f13ae34edcc68.text: The leak is out there, past the far ridge. Shut it off and I can go home. Do try to keep the survivors alive. It reads better.
